what: Identity pin for the vendored contract-lint trio, taken before the structure pass moved anything.
why: lint-parity.test.js is the only gate holding the vm canonical and the sdk copy byte-identical: there is no sync script. A rename that re-vendors the trio must reproduce these digests under the new names, or the two linters have drifted.
note: Canonical digests are graded by bin/pin_identity.js. SDK metadata is descriptive except for the stripped-globals sdkCommit, which bigint_surface_strip_threading.test.js resolves from the sibling SDK repository and compares byte-for-byte with the VM canonical file.
